aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When a road-view photography crew travels to the notorious Salmokji Reservoir to reshoot footage after a mysterious ghost-like figure is spotted on their map, they become trapped in a nightmare driven by dark, ancient waters.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Sent to the infamous Salmokji Reservoir to update street-view maps after an unsettling visual anomaly is captured, a production crew sets out to quickly complete their assignment. Led by producer Han Su-in, the team seeks not only to fix the mapping error but also to investigate the sudden disappearance of a senior colleague who last visited the site. As night falls over the secluded lake, eerie visual glitches, supernatural occurrences, and whispering voices from the murky depths begin to haunt the crew. Trapped by the reservoir's dark history and sinister waters, they must untangle the secret behind the lake before it claims them all.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: After a mysterious image resembling a ghostly figure appears on a public road-view mapping platform, a media company comes under heavy pressure to immediately re-survey the secluded Salmokji Reservoir. Producer Han Su-in volunteers to lead the reshoot team to the isolated site, driven partly by concern for her missing senior colleague, Woo Gyo-sil, who disappeared there days earlier. Accompanied by a veteran cameraman, a former Navy salvage specialist, a junior vlog creator, and a young production assistant, the crew arrives at the eerie reservoir aiming to finish their task quickly. However, as they begin reviewing newly recorded footage, they notice unsettling visual distortions and strange figures in the images that none of them saw in real time. The atmosphere turns sinister when Su-in's ex-boyfriend and fellow producer Ki-tae arrives to assist, just as the team makes a shocking encounter with their traumatized missing colleague. Forced to spend the night stranded near the water's edge, the group utilizes night-vision cameras and audio equipment, only to pick up eerie whispering sounds emanating from the lake. Tensions flare among the crew as they realize the reservoir is tied to a past unresolved crime and supernatural water spirits intent on dragging victims beneath the surface. One by one, the crew members succumb to hallucinatory visions and terrifying attacks driven by the entity residing in the depths. Su-in and Ki-tae must piece together the truth behind the cursed location while desperately trying to escape before the sinister waters consume them permanently.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Salmokji: Whispering Water is a chilling South Korean folk horror thriller set around the notorious Salmokji Reservoir in Yesan County. When a routine road-view mapping update reveals a horrifying anomaly—a ghost-like head floating near the water—a determined production team led by producer Han Su-in is dispatched to reshoot the area. Driven by the urgent need to rectify the footage and find her missing senior colleague who vanished at the site, Su-in and her crew step into a secluded landscape shrouded in unsettling urban legends. As the team utilizes specialized cameras and audio devices to document the surroundings, they encounter impossible visual glitches, strange apparitions, and haunting whispers calling to them from the deep, dark water. Blending found-footage aesthetics with atmospheric dread, the story explores the tragic past buried beneath the reservoir as the line between technical malfunction and supernatural malice dissolves.

story_structure.climax: Trapped at the remote reservoir, Su-in and her team face a desperate struggle for survival against the entity lurking in the deep water, reaching a peak of supernatural terror.
story_structure.conflict: Upon reviewing the new recordings, the crew notices terrifying visual anomalies and learns that a senior colleague previously disappeared at the reservoir, revealing that an unsolved mystery surrounds the location.
story_structure.resolution: The harrowing encounter comes to a haunting end, leaving the surviving crew members deeply traumatized while the disturbing secrets of Salmokji remain buried beneath the water.
story_structure.introduction: A road-view filming crew, led by producer Su-in, travels to the isolated Salmokji Reservoir to reshoot mapping footage after visual distortions and an unidentified figure were captured at the site.
story_structure.risingAction: As night falls, unsettling phenomena escalate—strange sounds emanate from the dark waters, equipment malfunctions, and malevolent entities begin terrorizing the team as paranoia grows within the group.
